plugins.label: AFK Plus
plugins.description: Detects players who stop moving during a round, warns them, then moves them to spectator. Admins can skip the punishment and spectate AFK players straight away.

cvars.label: Warning after (seconds)
cvars.description: Seconds without movement before the player is warned.

cvars.label: AFK after (seconds)
cvars.description: Seconds without movement before the player counts as AFK.

cvars.label: Move AFK players to spectator
cvars.description: Move a detected AFK player to the spectators.

cvars.label: Punish before spectating
cvars.description: On: works like the original plugin and punishes the AFK player until they die. Off: moves the player to spectator as soon as the AFK time is reached.

plugins.label: AFK Plus (legacy)
plugins.description: Legacy verion of AFK Plus for older Python systems. Use afkplus.py instead. Don't enable both.

cvars.label: Warning after (seconds)
cvars.description: Seconds without movement before the player is warned.

cvars.label: AFK after (seconds)
cvars.description: Seconds without movement before the player counts as AFK.

cvars.label: Move AFK players to spectator
cvars.description: Move a detected AFK player to the spectators.

cvars.label: Punish before spectating
cvars.description: On: works like the original plugin and punishes the AFK player until they die. Off: moves the player to spectator as soon as the AFK time is reached.

plugins.label: Aliases Plus
plugins.description: Modified aliases.py (replacement) to list player aliases without lagging the server. Results are limited or sent in chunks.

commands.name: alias
commands.description: List the names and Steam IDs a player has used.

cvars.label: Output mode
cvars.description: "limit" shows only the first results, "chunk" sends every result in delayed batches.

cvars.label: Result limit
cvars.description: Limit mode: maximum number of names/IDs shown.

cvars.label: Chunk delay (ms)
cvars.description: Chunk mode: delay in milliseconds between batches.

plugins.label: Auto Kick
plugins.description: Automatically kicks players (after a warning) for using words from the word list. Regex patterns can also go in autokick_patterns.txt, and incidents are logged to autokick.log.

commands.name: addword
commands.description: Add a word to the list.

commands.name: delword
commands.description: Remove a word from the list.

cvars.label: Warnings before kick
cvars.description: Number of warnings a player gets before being kicked.

cvars.label: Mode
cvars.description: "kick": warn then kick. "warn": block the message and notify the player, never kick. "silent": block the message without notifying anyone.

plugins.label: Backfire
plugins.description: Reflects team damage back onto the attacker (non-lethally, with a sound cue) and logs every incident. Needs g_friendlyfire 1 and a minqlx build with the damage hook (Shino's fork: github.com/mgaertne/minqlx).

cvars.label: Fixed slap damage
cvars.description: Damage dealt back per team hit when proportional mode is off.

cvars.label: Proportional damage
cvars.description: Deal back the same damage the attacker did, instead of the fixed amount.

cvars.label: Minimum health
cvars.description: Stop punishing below this health. 1 means the attacker never dies from backfire.

cvars.label: Log directory
cvars.description: Folder for backfire.log, relative to the server folder unless absolute.

plugins.label: Factory Vote
plugins.description: Lets players vote for a factory listed in baseq3/factories.txt. A matching <factory>.cfg in the plugins folder is run when the vote passes, and restore.cfg can reset the settings afterwards.

commands.name: factoryvote
commands.description: List factories, or start a vote for the numbered one.

commands.name: fv
commands.description: List factories, or start a vote for the numbered one.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Show the factory set on the server and in the plugin.

commands.name: restorecfg
commands.description: Run restore.cfg to reset cvars to their defaults (level set by ql_restorecfg_perm).

cvars.label: !restorecfg permission
cvars.description: Permission level needed for !restorecfg: 0 everyone, 1 regular, 2 mod, 3 admin, 4 superadmin. Read when the plugin loads.

plugins.label: Last Maps
plugins.description: Shows the last 5 played maps. Useful to avoid voting overplayed maps.

plugins.label: Live Scoreboard
plugins.description: Writes the live score to an HTML file, for example to show it in OBS.

commands.name: lscheck
commands.description: Check that the plugin is running.

commands.name: lsstyle
commands.description: Set the scoreboard style: 1 default, 2 one line.

commands.name: lstitle
commands.description: Set the scoreboard title. Leave blank to clear.

commands.name: lscustom
commands.description: Set custom text shown at the end of style 2. Leave blank to clear.

commands.name: lspath
commands.description: Set the output folder. Leave blank to show it, "clear" to reset it.

commands.name: resetls
commands.description: Reset all scoreboard settings to defaults.

cvars.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
cvars.description: How often the scoreboard file is rewritten.

cvars.label: Title
cvars.description: Scoreboard title.

cvars.label: Style
cvars.description: 1 = default layout, 2 = one line.

cvars.label: Red team name
cvars.description: Name shown for the Red team.

cvars.label: Blue team name
cvars.description: Name shown for the Blue team.

cvars.label: Text color
cvars.description: Hex text color, e.g. #ffffff.

cvars.label: Background color
cvars.description: Hex background color, e.g. #000000.

cvars.label: Custom text
cvars.description: Extra text shown at the end of style 2.

cvars.label: Output folder
cvars.description: Folder the HTML file is written to, e.g. /var/www/html/server2. Empty uses a livescores folder next to the plugins.

plugins.label: Map Manager
plugins.description: Manages map rotation from mappool.txt, enforces vote cooldowns on recently played maps, and tracks off-pool callvotes too. Includes the features of lastmaps.py, so don't enable both.

commands.name: mappool
commands.description: Show the next maps in rotation and which will be offered in the vote.

commands.name: skipmaps
commands.description: Advance the rotation by n maps (default 1).

commands.name: resetrotation
commands.description: Reload mappool.txt and resync the rotation to the current map.

commands.name: mmdebug
commands.description: Dump the plugin state for troubleshooting.

cvars.label: Map pool file
cvars.description: Full path to mappool.txt, including the filename. Set this to match your server.

cvars.label: Blocked recent maps
cvars.description: Number of recently played maps blocked from voting.

cvars.label: Vote candidates
cvars.description: Number of maps offered in the end-of-game vote.

cvars.label: Allow callvote after map vote
cvars.description: Allow callvote map after a map vote already passed this round.

plugins.label: MOTD (multi-line)
plugins.description: Replaces the stock motd.py with a message of the day of up to 10 lines. Lines set in the config are used only while no MOTD is stored; use !clearmotd and restart to reload them.

commands.name: addmotd
commands.description: Add a line in the next free slot.

commands.name: reloadmotd
commands.description: Reload MOTD lines from motd.cfg in baseq3.

cvars.label: Header
cvars.description: Header shown above the MOTD. Use \n for a line break.

cvars.label: Sound
cvars.description: Sound played when the MOTD is shown. Empty for no sound.

cvars.label: Line 1
cvars.description: MOTD line 1.

cvars.label: Line 2
cvars.description: MOTD line 2.

cvars.label: Line 3
cvars.description: MOTD line 3.

cvars.label: Line 4
cvars.description: MOTD line 4.

cvars.label: Line 5
cvars.description: MOTD line 5.

cvars.label: Line 6
cvars.description: MOTD line 6.

cvars.label: Line 7
cvars.description: MOTD line 7.

cvars.label: Line 8
cvars.description: MOTD line 8.

cvars.label: Line 9
cvars.description: MOTD line 9.

cvars.label: Line 10
cvars.description: MOTD line 10.

plugins.label: Names Plus
plugins.description: Replaces names.py. Lets admins set player names (by player or Steam ID), which persist across reconnects until cleared. Unloads names.py if it's loaded, so remove "names" (and DEFAULT) from qlx_plugins.

commands.name: enforce
commands.description: Apply stored names to everyone connected now.

cvars.label: Enforce admin-set names
cvars.description: Keep admin-set names on connect, name change and game start.

cvars.label: Enforce Steam names
cvars.description: Only allow names matching the player's Steam name.

commands.name: voteban
commands.description: Ban a player from calling a vote.

commands.name: voteunban
commands.description: Unban a player from calling a vote.

commands.name: votebanlist
commands.description: List players banned from calling votes.

cvars.label: Admin level for command usage
cvars.description: Minimum admin level required to use Voteban Plus commands.
